title: Nightcap shift: handoff plan & ops checklist
content:
Quick context: covering 23:00-03:00 PST window. Expected load: +15% on hosted-api due to EU batch jobs (see alert group 'hosted-api/high-async'). Focus areas: GPU pool capacity, rack-level NIC flaps, and KV cache warmups for scheduled batch windows.

Priority checklist (do in order):
1) Check capacity pools dashboard (Console > Dedicated > Pools) — verify median utilization < 72% across us-west-2-pool-a. If >80% spin up burst nodes: run `infractl pool scale --pool us-west-2-pool-a --add 2 --reason "night burst"`. Note: burst nodes are on preemptible GPUs, track eviction risk.

2) Networking quick health: look at fabric errors on racks 17-19 in Observability > Network > Fabric. If packet drops >0.2% persist for 5m, open INFRA ticket and reroute affected nodes: `netops reroute --rack 17`. Notify @net-ops in #infra-net.

3) GPU node flapping: grep recent flaps: `kubectl get nodes -l pool=us-west-2-pool-a -o wide | grep -i flapping` — if found, drain node and mark for reprovision: `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets && infractl reprovision <node>`. Attach logs to GH PR 876 if kernel OOM seen.

4) KV cache warmup for repeated prompt sets: run warmup job if cache hit rate < 45% for the last hour: `scripts/warmup_kv.sh --model rwinstruct-v1 --samples 150`. Note TODO: confirm warmup job doesn't hog GPU memory >6GB (seen once).

Emergency fallbacks: if hosted-api latency p50 > 350ms use routing policy to failover to cheaper variant: `apictl route set --policy latency-fallback --target rwinstruct-v1-quant`. Monitor quality alerts channel #model-quality during fallback.

Handoff notes for morning SRE:
- Left pool us-west-2-pool-a at 2 nodes above baseline (due to burst). Please scale down to baseline if sustained thermal alarms settle.
- Rack 18 NIC jitter resolved after soft-reboot; PR ticket created INFRA-342 (link above).
- Warmup job ran at 00:45, KV hit rate improved from 37% -> 62% for rwinstruct-v1.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Why did one warmup pod request 12GB (should be 6GB)? Check starter image versions (maybe drift to latest runtime image).
- Confirm autoscaler cooldown is 8m not 10m for this pool (seen conflicting docs in Confluence).

Quick log snippets (local times):
- 23:18: Alert: hosted-api/p50 spike -> traced to EU batch; scaled pool +1, latency back to baseline by 23:26.
- 00:07: Node ip-10-0-67-121 flapping -> drained, reprovision kicked at 00:12.
- 00:46: Warmup job run; KV hit rate +25pt.

Escalation contacts:
- On-call infra: Jordan Lee (pager)
- Net-ops lead: Alicia Moreno (Slack DM)
- Platform eng lead: Priya Sharma (for policy exceptions)

Final handoff: check inbox for any new alerts, paste this doc into #shift-handoffs, and ping Jordan if anything outstanding.

Notes to self: capture reproducible steps for the warmup memory spike, open a small repro PR next shift. Keep this page as the single-source handoff for the night.

End of shift checklist (tick on next edit):
- [ ] Scale pools back to baseline if burst nodes not used
- [ ] Confirm warmup image version pinned
- [ ] Attach logs to INFRA-342 and GH PR 876

Unresolved tickets to follow up: INFRA-342, OPS-1197

-- Samira (nightcap)
